prompts.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium campaign poster for OMERTÀ, a noir mafia RPG, promoting its new Market V2 contract system. Portrait 4:5 composition, ideally 1080 by 1350 pixels. This is the first poster in a tightly art-directed luxury editorial series. Palette: near-black ink #08090a, warm ivory #f2eadb, antique brass gold #cba65c, restrained desaturated teal #6eafc8. No purple, no neon cyberpunk, no colorful crypto logos.
Visual: a monumental 1930s bank-vault door open around a beautifully detailed miniature nocturnal city, rain-dark stone buildings, a few warm windows, precise brass ledger compartments in foreground, understated teal reflections. Cinematic noir photography mixed with exquisitely crafted architectural model; tactile steel, paper, stone, deep rich blacks and film grain. Editorial restraint, rich chiaroscuro, very high craft. No human faces, no guns, no coin piles, no rising price chart. Illustration occupies lower two thirds with quiet black negative space above for superbly composed typography. Typography must be sharp and correct, a very large tightly set condensed ivory headline with small elegant gold serif OMERTÀ wordmark. Clear mobile readability, strict optical alignment, generous safe margins. No mockup frame: full bleed final poster.
Exact text to include, and no other text:
Top small wordmark: "OMERTÀ"
Small tracking label: "MARKET V2"
Large headline over three lines: "THE CITY" / "HAS A" / "TREASURY."
Small supporting line below headline: "Liquidity. Reserves. Bonds. Turf."
At bottom in clearly readable small type: "BUILT & TESTED · NOT DEPLOYED"
Bottom right: "OMERTA.FUN"
Maintain visual hierarchy: headline first, extraordinary city-in-vault image second, status still legible. The image must not imply the contracts are live or promise returns. Avoid tiny explanatory text, generic dashboard boxes, stock marketing gradients and fake logos.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium editorial campaign poster for OMERTÀ Market V2. Portrait 4:5 composition, ideally 1080 by 1350 pixels. Match a sophisticated 1930s financial noir campaign: near-black ink #08090a, warm ivory #f2eadb, antique brass #cba65c and quiet desaturated teal #6eafc8, tactile paper, steel and smoke-light. No purple or neon. Final flat poster, no mockup frame.
Visual: overhead at an oblique cinematic angle, a long dark walnut treasury desk under a brass banker's lamp. Seven distinct open brass ledger drawers/capital compartments form a beautifully composed architectural arc around an ivory ledger, with subtle map contours and precise gold lines linking them. An atmosphere of deliberation and rigorous treasury operations, almost museum-quality financial still life. Visible paper and drawer interiors, physically finite storage, not piles of money or gold coins. No readable diagram labels in the artwork, no graphs suggesting price appreciation. Broad clean black upper area for typography. Huge tight condensed ivory headline with refined gold serif wordmark, exact mobile-readable type, generous safe margins.
Exact text, no other text:
Top: "OMERTÀ"
Small label: "MARKET V2 / THE RESERVE DESK"
Headline in three lines: "CAPITAL" / "WITH" / "ORDERS."
Supporting line: "Seven compartments. Finite budgets."
Bottom status: "BUILT & TESTED · NOT DEPLOYED"
Bottom right: "OMERTA.FUN"
The design should feel collectible and commanding: a film one-sheet with information discipline. Exceptional realistic lighting and texture, asymmetrical balance, no generic app cards, no yield or safety promises.

Use case: ads-marketing. Create a finished premium noir editorial campaign poster for OMERTÀ Market V2, portrait 4:5 ideally1080x1350. Visual system: charcoal-black #08090a, warm ivory #f2eadb, aged brass-gold #cba65c, muted petrol teal #6eafc8. High-end cinema-poster craft with realistic small architectural models and tactile paper map. No purple neon, no generic cryptocurrency visuals.
Visual: a commanding isometric tabletop model of a 1930s rain-soaked mafia city, dark brick districts, narrow streets, a canal and small bridges. Several crisp understated brass borders mark districts on an archival city map. Two understated differently colored wax seals and pins suggest families contesting territory. One lit band crosses the model like a district boundary, not a financial price chart. An anonymous gloved hand just at the lower edge moves a small brass marker; no weapons or faces. The city occupies the lower two thirds. Top area deep clean black with bold editorial typography, not type over busy architecture. Strong negative space and exquisite legible headline.
Exact text and no additional text:
Top wordmark: "OMERTÀ"
Small tracking label: "MARKET V2 / FAMILY TURF"
Huge ivory condensed headline in three lines: "CONTROL" / "THE" / "TURF."
Supporting copy on two lines: "Family fee rights." / "Protocol-owned principal."
Bottom readable status: "BUILT & TESTED · NOT DEPLOYED"
Bottom right: "OMERTA.FUN"
Luxury noir gaming campaign with dramatic but restrained light and paper grain. Meticulous typography, correct spelling and OMERTÀ accent, generous margins, no guaranteed rewards, no live availability claim. Full bleed flat final artwork.
